title: Roles Anywhere Persistence
description: IAM Roles Anywhere allows workloads outside of AWS (e.g., on-premises servers) to obtain temporary credentials using X.509 certificates. An attacker with rolesanywhere:CreateTrustAnchor and rolesanywhere:CreateProfile creates a trust anchor that trusts a certificate authority the attacker controls. They create a profile that maps the certificate to a privileged IAM role. The attacker then uses a certificate from their CA to assume the role from any infrastructure, establishing persistence that does not rely on IAM users or access keys.
